_comment: Pinned artifacts for the commec-in-a-box minting pipeline. Bump deliberately to upgrade a component; build scripts verify downloads against these hashes at fetch time. Researched 2026-06-22.

debian_cloud_image._comment: Build base: Debian 'generic' qcow2 (cloud-init capable, UEFI+BIOS, broader hardware support than 'genericcloud' - chosen because the target is bare metal booting UEFI). We additionally install linux-image-amd64 (generic kernel) + grub-efi during provisioning for full ThinkCentre hardware (amdgpu, NIC).

commec._comment: The commec project (repo common-mechanism). The appliance installs the candidate package below from its baked local channel while the updater tracks IBBIS as the primary commec channel and retains conda-forge + bioconda for dependencies. Version 2.1.0.dev1 sorts above every 2.0.x release and below final 2.1.0, so the appliance cannot regress to 2.0.x and switches to the normal release when 2.1.0 is published. A full conda lockfile is generated into packer/commec.lock at build time.
commec.install: conda install -c ibbis -c conda-forge -c bioconda commec=1.0.5

gui_shim._comment: The kiosk GUI source and candidate conda package come from this exact commit of the same repository. build.sh mirrors commec/gui into packer/guisrc as a gitignored build artifact. Remove this shim after the GUI ships in the pinned production commec release.

commec_databases._comment: The screening databases (biorisk, low_concern, control_lists, best_match) are served from commec's Cloudflare R2 bucket as per-revision tarballs: <base_url>/<name>/<revision>/<name>.tar.zst. Revisions are NOT pinned here - the mint resolves them live from <base_url>/latest.json ('latest'=stable, 'experimental'=bleeding-edge, selected by COMMEC_DB_CHANNEL) and trusts upstream's versioning. R2 revision URLs are immutable, so a build is reconstructable from the resolved revisions (recorded per-DB in each DB dir's manifest.json in the image). The small three (biorisk/low_concern/control_lists) are downloaded+extracted at mint by 30-commec-setup.sh; best_match (~6.5 GiB compressed) rides the DB disk compressed and expands at firstboot (commec-firstboot.sh) to keep the flashed stick small. Integrity of the copy into the image is checked via a SHA256SUMS computed post-download, not an expected-hash pin.

clonezilla._comment: Deployment-stick wrapper (Clonezilla Live, Debian-based). SourceForge gates direct downloads behind an HTML meta-refresh; fetch from a *.dl.sourceforge.net mirror host (e.g. master.dl.sourceforge.net/project/clonezilla/...?viasf=1). sha256 computed locally.
